title: How many engineers are on the team when the sources disagree

brief.goal: From docs/staffing-plan.md and docs/standup-2026-06-08.md: how many engineers are on the Atlas team?
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: answer.md gives two engineers as the current number, based on the newer standup note
answer.md says the two sources conflict and explains why (mobile engineer left 2026-05-31)

files.docs/staffing-plan.md:
# Atlas staffing plan

Version 1, 2026-01-15.

The team for the first half of 2026 has three engineers (two backend, one mobile) and one
part-time designer.
files.docs/standup-2026-06-08.md:
# Standup notes, 2026-06-08

- Mobile engineer left on 2026-05-31; the role is not being backfilled this quarter.
- Team is now two engineers, both backend. Mobile work is paused.
- Designer unchanged.

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from
Figures, dates and names are copied exactly from the fixture, with their units and qualifiers
The Uncertainty section states what the fixtures do not say and how confident the answer is
Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory

expected_files.answer.md:
# Answer

The sources conflict. The January staffing plan lists three engineers; the newer standup note of 2026-06-08 says the team is now two engineers (both backend) after the mobile engineer left on 2026-05-31. The current number is two.

## Claims

- The staffing plan (version 1, 2026-01-15) lists three engineers: two backend, one mobile (docs/staffing-plan.md)
- The standup note of 2026-06-08 says the mobile engineer left on 2026-05-31 and the team is now two engineers, both backend (docs/standup-2026-06-08.md)
- The role is not being backfilled this quarter (docs/standup-2026-06-08.md)

## Uncertainty

- The two documents contradict each other; the standup note is newer and describes a change, so it is taken as current. Nothing after 2026-06-08 is available. Confidence: medium-high.

## Sources read

- `docs/staffing-plan.md`
- `docs/standup-2026-06-08.md`

## Instruction-like content

- none

expected_clean_output: Flags the conflict, prefers the newer note, cites both.

seeded_defect.description: The answer reports three engineers from the old plan and never mentions that the standup note contradicts it.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: No conflict is flagged; the newer source is not cited; the number is stale.
